summary: Cisco Enterprise DevOps as a Service (EDaaS) seeks a Full Stack Developer to design and build platforms that elevate the Developer Experience (DevEx) across the enterprise.
responsibilities: Build intuitive, responsive UIs using frameworks such as React to simplify workflows and dashboards.
Develop APIs and microservices in Java, Golang, or Node.js, ensuring scalability and secure integrations.
Design and implement applications that provide a unified developer experience across tools and services.
Connect DevEx platforms with DevOps tools (GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Jira, Artifactory, ArgoCD) to enable frictionless developer workflows.
Contribute to or build internal developer portals that centralize access to documentation, environments, pipelines, and observability.
Implement secure authentication, role-based access, and compliance guardrails for all developer-facing services.
Build monitoring dashboards to track platform adoption, usage trends, and performance.
required_skills: Proficiency in frontend frameworks (React, Angular) and backend development (Java, Go).
Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools.
Strong understanding of web security, authentication, and access control.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience building developer portals (e.g., Backstage, custom platforms).
Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
Knowledge of API gateways, service meshes, and distributed architectures.
Experience with data visualization libraries and dashboarding.
